name: mosfet-to-riscv
description: An interactive journey from a single MOSFET to a multi-core RISC-V processor. Every block is a transparent box.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite-node scripts/hwstats.ts && vite-node scripts/lens-routes.ts && vite-node scripts/example-thumbs.ts && vite-node scripts/chapter-manifest.ts --index && vite build
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.layout:fetch: gh release download layout-latest -p layout.tar.gz -D layout --clobber && mkdir -p public/layout && tar -xzf layout/layout.tar.gz -C public/layout
